grades: High school grades 9 to 12 (middle school grades 5 to 8 has a separate group)
name: Pennsylvania FBLA (Future Business Leaders of America)
city: Pennsylvania (statewide, state office in Jersey Shore)
what_you_do: Join a business student group at your school. You compete in business events, go to region and state conferences and build leadership skills.
who_can_apply: Students in grades 9 to 12. If your school has no chapter, you can join the Virtual Chapter. It is open if you are homeschooled or in a cyber charter, private or charter school. It is also open if your school has no FBLA chapter. The Virtual Chapter page says members must take a business class. Students at schools with an active FBLA chapter cannot join it.
pay_detail: Yearly dues $18 for high school ($10 national and $8 state). Virtual Chapter dues are $16.
duration: School year; the 2027 State Leadership Conference is April 12 to 14, 2027 at the Hershey Lodge and Giant Center
deadline_text: Join through your chapter adviser any time. Next State Leadership Conference: April 12 to 14, 2027.
how_to_apply: Ask your chapter adviser at school. If you do not know who that is, contact Bruce Boncal, PA FBLA Executive Director, bboncal@pafbla.us. Virtual Chapter members fill out an online application signed by a parent.
notes: Virtual Chapter members pay their own travel costs. State office: (570) 398-4652, stateoffice@pafbla.us.
